bugs.text: Tractor-beam capture can never trigger: the beam check rejects any fighter with y > boss.y + 120, but the boss stops at y=126 and the player sits at y=256 (246 max). The entire capture / dual-fighter / rescue / hostile-captive chain (E2-E6) is dead code; the beam just plays its animation and the boss returns.

During the Challenging Stage (stage 3, 7, ...) updateChallenge only moves the enemies: updatePlayer, updateBullets, updateExplosions and the collision functions are not called, so the player cannot move or shoot for the whole stage, no hits are possible, and the results screen always shows 0 hits / 0 bonus.
The 2-frame 'wing animation' is a one-pixel vertical shift of the same bitmap, so enemies bob instead of flapping.
Formation sway never stops after the formation is complete; sway and breathing run at the same time.
All five entry groups start at once and the full 40-enemy fill takes about 1.5 s, so the entry phase is over almost before it is seen.
When any boss is in formation, about 45% of all dive launches are boss dives (r < 0.45), far more boss-heavy than the arcade.
sndEnemyHit is defined but never played; a non-fatal hit on a Boss uses sndBossHit and everything else is the destroy sound.
Goei flying as escorts never fire (escort state is excluded from the shooter list).
During the GAME OVER card the enemies and bullets freeze in place for 2.5 s rather than continuing to move.

summary: The code is cleanly organised: explicit state objects, a state-machine update dispatcher, a separate render pass, a real fixed-timestep loop and a tidy bitmap font and sprite factory, and the play-test ran clean. The normal stages feel reasonably like Galaga: a correct 40-ship formation with breathing, curved entries and dives with aimed fire, bosses with escorts and the right score ladder, two-hit bosses that change colour, ramming kills, READY/respawn with a dive hold, and proper HUD, badges, results and high score. Two off-by-geometry mistakes undo much of the spec though: the tractor beam stops 10 px short of the player's row, so the signature capture/dual-fighter mechanic, although written in full, can never occur, and the Challenging Stage update forgets to run the player, bullets and collisions, so the player is a frozen spectator for stage 3 and scores nothing. The sprites are also only loosely Galaga-like with a 1 px bob for animation. It plays as a solid, fair arcade shooter with the bonus mechanics missing.
